title: First-order equations

examples.title: Build a family of solutions
examples.description: Combine independent solutions and choose coefficients to match initial conditions.

examples.description: Separate transient and forced responses in a nonhomogeneous equation.

examples.description: Change the driving frequency and observe the oscillator's response.

examples.title: Meet both boundaries
examples.description: Vary an eigenvalue parameter until a solution satisfies both endpoint conditions.

examples.description: Connect matrix action, eigenvectors, and the growth or decay of a solution.
